fato_historico: 1914: A German submarine sinks three British cruisers over a seventy-minute period, killing almost 1,500 sailors.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos suggests you navigate your emotions with gentle grace today. Much like historical tides that once shifted the course of destiny in minutes, your inner world may experience sudden, rapid changes. Consider this an invitation to stay grounded. It is a good time to release past anchors and drift toward calmer, more purposeful, and hopeful coastal waters.
frase_do_dia: Trust the flow of the tides to carry you toward your true North.
significado_numero: Represents the awakening of spiritual intuition and hidden personal potential.
conselho: Focus on the present moment and let go of heavy burdens today.
